scope: Performance/index provisioning only; existing server-side tenant/global filters are unchanged; no security-isolation or live-latency claim.
implementation: ensure_collection reconciles metadata.tenant_id keyword index for existing and newly created collections.
Existing keyword indexes and their options are accepted without writes; incompatible or malformed declared index configuration fails without replacement.
Missing index uses PUT /collections/{collection}/index?wait=true with field_schema=keyword; requires completed result and GET schema readback.
HTTP errors preserve QdrantHTTPError.status; network and JSON errors propagate; unexpected API response, acknowledged/wait_timeout or absent postcondition fail honestly.
No DELETE, collection recreation for existing data, payload rewrite, HNSW tuning or is_tenant rollout.

old_red.claim: Both existing/no-index and newly-created collection fail to acquire tenant index on baseline code.

tests.ruff: check passed; formatting applied only to two changed files

api_sources.fact: PUT index endpoint, field_name + keyword field_schema; wait=true waits for changes.
Nested fields use dot notation; payload indexes cost resources; existing-data HNSW edge benefits can require separate rebuild.

compatibility: Current canonical docker-compose.v9.yml pins Qdrant v1.17.1. Keyword-only shape avoids adding optional is_tenant behavior to older compose/test versions; this HTTP client uses urllib, not qdrant-client.
deployment_scope: Automatic reconciliation runs only when HybridQdrantRetriever.ingest calls ensure_collection. Search, readiness and seed do not acquire new write behavior.
Existing collections with no later ingest require a separately authorized explicit ensure_tenant_payload_index call against a confirmed target. No remote call was made.
Creating an index can consume CPU/RAM/disk and exceed the existing 20s HTTP timeout. Timeout remains failure; retry safely reads current schema first.
No HNSW rebuild is performed. The index presence contract is fixed in code; live performance and full filter-aware HNSW benefit need operational evidence on the identified deployment.
rollback: Revert code if required. An already-created compatible keyword index can remain; do not automatically delete indexes or recreate collections. Any operational index removal must be a separate approved action after impact review.
remaining_ci: test_impact.sh --plan run with BASE=53652e02: engine binds neither changed path to a capability and requests full suite; 176 targeted tests are measured evidence, not substitute for required full CI.
Root must add brain/provenance entries and run required preflight/generation/publication gates on the final integrated head before pushing.
No deployment, remote commit, PR, local commit, dependency upgrade, shared-worktree source edit or generated-artifact change by this agent.
